achieved: Fixed global seed; per-run reseeding; config + architecture fingerprints on every checkpoint, with stale artefacts refused rather than resumed.
Pinned dependency FLOORS verified post-import (exact pins were unsatisfiable on CPython 3.13); resolved versions recorded in the manifest.
SHA-256 provenance on every corpus; pinned OPUS release URLs; a failed fetch raises and never substitutes.
Gates G1a/G1b/G1c, G2-G16 as runnable code that halts on failure. Nine defects were caught at gate time, including an NFC offset error that silently corrupted a fraction of decoded MT output.
Seed dispersion and paired bootstrap reported separately, Holm-corrected, computed in code and written to CSV/JSON.
MT, NER and probes share a tokenizer build and config_hash per run, so the task-transfer comparison is well posed.
Scrambled control present at fertility level(s) ['F1', 'F2'].
not_achieved: Bitwise determinism: T4 fp16 reductions under AMP are not bitwise reproducible. Protocol-level reproducibility is claimed; bitwise reproducibility of a forward pass is not.
Indonesian MT and NER: cut on measured evidence (0.18% fertility separation vs 7.00% for Tagalog). H2 rests on the classifier-agreement probe alone, which returned null.
Scrambled control absent at level(s) ['F0']; effects there are uncontrolled.
Supervision-ladder rung 3 (full morphological analyzer): no maintained Philippine analyzer exists off the shelf; rungs 1-2 only. G1a coverage 9/10 fixture roots.
Tagalog UD tagging: TRG=55 and Ugnayan=94 sentences, unusable; WikiANN tl substituted and the substitution logged.
URL-level contamination checking: OPUS Moses format carries no URL metadata, so G9 is text-level only. Measured contamination was 0.0% by exact, near-duplicate and containment matching.
Strong LID for bitext filtering unless lid.176.ftz is supplied; the function-word fallback is weak on short sentences.

Every model is under-trained at ~1.6 epochs (1,500 MT steps), with greedy decoding and evaluation capped at 500 FLORES / 300 in-domain sentences. This applies identically across conditions, so contrasts hold while absolute scores are floor-level (chrF 6-11).
The Tagalog voice probe is circular by construction (G15 trivial-baseline accuracy 1.000 under MorphAustro-Tok, 0.000 under BPE) and carries no evidential weight.
Tagalog train/test register gap: ParaCrawl is labelled Tagalog, FLORES+ is Filipino (fil_Latn); type-Jaccard 0.179 with 60.9% of test types unseen in training.
void_run_note: Runs before the throughput rescale halted MT mid-training and left NER at step 1/3000 and the voice probe at step 1/1500. Their rows are excluded from analysis; their compute remains in the ledger.

findings.H1_infix_aware_helps_tagalog_MT: NOT SUPPORTED as a typological claim
findings.H3_gain_not_reducible_to_tokens_per_char: SUPPORTED (gain grows with coarser fertility: +0.84 -> +1.49 -> +3.40 chrF)
findings.capacity_confound: ruled out: corr(parameter advantage, chrF gain) = -0.810
findings.task_transfer: no transfer; pearson r=-0.366 (p=0.333), spearman rho=-0.450, n=9

limitations: Lines that could not be round-tripped exactly by every tokenizer condition were excluded from all splits: {'tgl': 1, 'ind': 0}. A non-invertible line would be mis-decoded if kept, so exclusion is strictly safer; the rate is under 0.5% and identical across conditions.

PROBE CIRCULARITY (measured): the Tagalog voice probe is solved outright by a trivial baseline that reads the <INF:...> token alone -- G15 accuracy 1.000 under MorphAustro-Tok vs 0.000 under matched BPE. It is reported as DIAGNOSTIC, not evidential, and carries no independent weight for H1; H1 rests on MT and NER, which are non-circular. The Indonesian classifier-agreement probe is a corruption-judgment task and is unaffected.

DESIGN REVISION (measured, not preferred): the Indonesian MT and NER arms were cut after the live gate run showed MorphAustro-Tok and matched BPE separate by only 0.18% in tokens/char on Indonesian (vs 7.00% on Tagalog), the mechanism touching 0.258% of tokens. H2 is tested by the classifier-agreement probe alone; its MT and NER claims go unrun. The freed 4.41 GPU-hours fund 5 seeds on Tagalog instead of 3 (t_crit 4.30 -> 2.78).

Tagalog train (ParaCrawl, tgl) / test (FLORES+, fil_Latn) register gap: {'type_jaccard': 0.17865858167566367, 'test_types_unseen_in_train': 0.6088082901554405}.
LID backend for bitext filtering: function_word_heuristic.
MT training bitext is web-mined ParaCrawl; absolute scores are low and only controlled within-language contrasts are interpretable.
G9 is text-level only: OPUS Moses format carries no URL metadata, so URL-level contamination checking is not possible on the training side.

Parameter parity holds at matched vocabulary but NOT at matched fertility, where it is impossible by construction: {'tgl/F0': 0.14818779629912832, 'tgl/F1': 0.11520594611334778, 'tgl/F2': 0.0277554765454754, 'ind/F1': 0.0}. MorphAustro-Tok requires a larger vocabulary to reach a given tokens-per-character (morph-constrained merges are less efficient per entry), so it carries more embedding parameters at every sweep level. Any matched-fertility win for MorphAustro-Tok is therefore not separable from capacity and is reported as such.
